questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'I am a teacher,' she said.
options: She said she is a teacher.
She said she was a teacher.
She said I am a teacher.
She said I was a teacher.
explanation: En style indirect, on décale le présent 'am' en passé 'was'. On dit : 'She said she was a teacher.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'We are going to Douala,' they said.
options: They said they are going to Douala.
They said they were going to Douala.
They said we were going to Douala.
They said we are going to Douala.
explanation: Le présent continu 'are going' devient 'were going' au style indirect. On dit : 'They said they were going to Douala.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'I have finished my work,' he said.
options: He said he had finished his work.
He said he has finished his work.
He said I had finished my work.
He said he finished his work.
explanation: Le present perfect 'have finished' devient past perfect 'had finished' au style indirect. On dit : 'He said he had finished his work.'

questionText: Choose the correct reporting verb: She ______ me that she was happy.
options: said
told
asked
explained
explanation: On utilise 'told' quand on mentionne la personne à qui on parle (me). On dit : 'She told me that she was happy.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'Where is the market?' he asked.
options: He asked where is the market.
He asked where the market was.
He asked where was the market.
He asked the market where is.
explanation: Dans le style indirect, la question devient une phrase déclarative avec le sujet avant le verbe. On dit : 'He asked where the market was.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'Do you like Makossa music?' she asked.
options: She asked if I like Makossa music.
She asked if I liked Makossa music.
She asked if I did like Makossa music.
She asked do you like Makossa music.
explanation: Les questions fermées (oui/non) sont introduites par 'if' ou 'whether'. Le présent 'like' devient 'liked' au style indirect. On dit : 'She asked if I liked Makossa music.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'Please help me,' she said.
options: She said me to help her.
She told me to help her.
She asked me to help her.
She said help her.
explanation: Pour les demandes, on utilise souvent 'asked + someone + to + infinitive'. On dit : 'She asked me to help her.'

questionText: Choose the correct reporting verb: He ______ (explain/say) the rules clearly.
options: said
told
explained
asked
explanation: 'Explained' est le verbe approprié car il y a un complément d'objet direct ('the rules'). On dit : 'He explained the rules clearly.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'I will visit you tomorrow,' he said.
options: He said he will visit me tomorrow.
He said he would visit me the next day.
He said he would visit me tomorrow.
He said he will visit me the next day.
explanation: 'Will' devient 'would' au style indirect et 'tomorrow' devient 'the next day'. On dit : 'He said he would visit me the next day.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'Where do you live?' he asked her.
options: He asked her where she lived.
He asked her where did she live.
He asked her where she lives.
He asked her where do you live.
explanation: Dans le style indirect, la question devient une phrase déclarative : sujet + verbe. On dit : 'He asked her where she lived.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'I can speak French,' she said.
options: She said she can speak French.
She said she could speak French.
She said she will speak French.
She said she speaks French.
explanation: 'Can' devient 'could' au style indirect. On dit : 'She said she could speak French.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'Don't forget to call me,' he said.
options: He said me not to forget to call him.
He told me not to forget to call him.
He asked me don't forget to call him.
He told me don't forget to call him.
explanation: Pour les commandes négatives, on utilise 'tell + someone + not to + infinitive'. On dit : 'He told me not to forget to call him.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'I was sleeping when you called,' he said.
options: He said he had been sleeping when I called.
He said he was sleeping when I called.
He said he had been sleeping when you called.
He said he slept when I called.
explanation: Le past continuous 'was sleeping' devient past perfect continuous 'had been sleeping'. On dit : 'He said he had been sleeping when I called.'

questionText: Choose the correct reporting verb: The teacher ______ (suggest/say) that we should study more.
options: said
told
suggested
asked
explanation: 'Suggested' est le verbe approprié pour une suggestion. On dit : 'The teacher suggested that we should study more.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'What time does the bus leave?' he asked.
options: He asked what time the bus leaves.
He asked what time did the bus leave.
He asked what time the bus left.
He asked what time does the bus leave.
explanation: Dans le style indirect, le présent 'leaves' devient passé 'left'. On dit : 'He asked what time the bus left.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'Could you help me with this?' she asked.
options: She asked if I could help her with that.
She asked if I can help her with that.
She asked could I help her with that.
She asked if I could help me with this.
explanation: 'Could' reste généralement 'could' au style indirect (c'est déjà un modal passé). On dit : 'She asked if I could help her with that.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'If I were you, I would accept the offer,' she said.
options: She said if she were me, she would accept the offer.
She said if she had been me, she would have accepted the offer.
She said if I were her, I would accept the offer.
She said if she were me, she will accept the offer.
explanation: Le second conditionnel ('If I were you') reste au style indirect car il exprime une situation hypothétique. On dit : 'She said if she were me, she would accept the offer.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'Let's go to the cinema,' he suggested.
options: He suggested to go to the cinema.
He suggested going to the cinema.
He suggested we go to the cinema.
He suggested to go to the cinema.
explanation: Avec 'suggest', on utilise 'suggest + -ing' ou 'suggest + that + clause'. On dit : 'He suggested going to the cinema.' ou 'He suggested that we go to the cinema.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'I must finish this report today,' she said.
options: She said she must finish that report today.
She said she had to finish that report that day.
She said she must finish that report that day.
She said she had to finish this report today.
explanation: 'Must' exprimant une obligation devient 'had to' au style indirect. 'Today' devient 'that day'. On dit : 'She said she had to finish that report that day.'

questionText: Transform to reported speech: 'I have been waiting for you for an hour,' he said.
options: He said he has been waiting for me for an hour.
He said he had been waiting for me for an hour.
He said he had been waiting for you for an hour.
He said he has been waiting for you for an hour.
explanation: Le present perfect continuous 'have been waiting' devient past perfect continuous 'had been waiting'. On dit : 'He said he had been waiting for me for an hour.'
